name: Memory & Knowledge Search
description: Search Yuihime's persistent memory and knowledge base (conversation history, facts, notes, and learned information) using a natural-language query. Use this to retrieve specific past information, facts the user shared, or recalled context before answering.

query.description: The search query in natural language (e.g., 'what did we discuss about the API key', 'user favorite color').

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 5, max 20).

type.description: Optional filter by memory type (e.g., 'knowledge', 'chat', 'note'). Omit to search everything.
